findings.note: Stale comment: the --from-run validation comment still says a run id is a path segment under .metareview/runs/; the store is now <common>/metareview/runs/. Comment-only.

Plain `metareview status` can print the unmigrated-0.13.x-runs notice twice: once from status.buildFor Warnings (LegacyRunsPending) and once from the FSM section (fsmcli.StatusLines pending line). Cosmetic duplication; both derive from run.PendingLegacyRuns so they never disagree.

MigrateLegacyRows writes the legacy-ledger.size stamp even when it reported conflicts, so a STORE_COLLISION ledger-row warning appears once and is then silent until the legacy file changes. Run-directory collisions, by contrast, re-warn on every command. Minor asymmetry, not data loss (the conflicting row is never merged and the legacy file is untouched).
